unit: MW facility power (Epoch "Power (MW)"); H100 equivalents as published by Epoch; capex_busd in billions of 2025 USD (Epoch "Total capital cost")
method: Epoch AI frontier data-center tracker, US sites (Country = United States). Each value is the latest dated observation or Epoch projection on or before the date: year end for 2025-2028, the retrieval date for "now"; "final" is the last projected level (to 2030). A site before its first observation counts 0 MW; a blank cell is skipped, not read as zero. State is parsed from the Address field (2-letter code or full state name). Where the address names none, a reviewed override applies only if the site's own Epoch "Selected Sources" text names the state (state_basis "source text") or the site name does unambiguously ("site name"); the supporting text is kept in state_evidence. Sites with no supported state keep state null and are listed in "unlocated". Power is Epoch facility power ("Power (MW)" in data_center_timelines.csv); the "Current power (MW)" column of data_centers.csv is IT power and is not used. Each site also carries "series": its facility MW at every dated change (latest observation on or before a date gives the level); dates after the retrieval date are Epoch projections. "capex_busd" and "capex_series" are Epoch's estimated total capital cost (compute + construction, billions of 2025 USD, rounded to 0.01) by the same rule; they are Epoch model estimates, not company-reported spend. A blank cell is skipped, not read as zero. Covers tracked frontier campuses only, not every data center. Planned levels are Epoch projections and can slip.
